unconsidered_routes.title: Fixed-step accumulator with render interpolation
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Run the domain at a constant 1/60 s step driven by an accumulator in PlaySession, and let the renderer lerp between the last two states. Entities then produce identical traces for identical inputs regardless of display rate.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Glenn Fiedler 'Fix Your Timestep'; every deterministic lockstep game
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces the raw-dt call in PlaySession and the 0.25 s clamp; makes eval fast-forward a loop count.

unconsidered_routes.title: Motion as a tiny state machine with explicit outcomes
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Give each mover a MoveIntent {target, mode, onComplete} and have the step return Arrived | Blocked | Interrupted per entity. Waypoint paths, direct steer and presence snaps are three producers of the same outcome; the behaviour commit consumes only outcomes.
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces the implicit 'path empty means arrived' rule in enterPerformingDwell and fixes S3A-01 structurally.

unconsidered_routes.title: Navmesh-free steering with dwell-site slots
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Keep waypoints for room-to-room routing but give each prop/seat a tiny slot list and let direct steer handle the last metre. Avoids waypoint spam for 05d and removes the need for the 0.05 m snap hacks in separation.
unconsidered_routes.reference: The Sims / Dwarf Fortress 'use-site' slots; RimWorld interaction cells
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Changes how arrival is defined; separation snap-radius logic can shrink.
